code: Title screen: tap X 39-54 times in 360 frames

note: The beta checks (count & $F8) = $28, a narrower window: every 9 frames works, every 7 does not.

code: IPS patches/sb3_soft_reset_<eu|jp|beta>.ips, then hold Select+Start+L+R on pad 1
effect: Soft reset to the Hudson logo / title screen (restores the unreferenced check at $C0:013A)
note: The check (LDA $4E / CMP #$33 / JML $80F000) is in all three ROMs but nothing calls it. The patch moves the pad routine's PLX/PLY/RTL at $C0:0137 so the check runs every frame. Built and verified by tools/sb3/make_ips.py; tested in Mesen on EU, JP and the beta.
